reviews.text:
I occasionally use their services for pet grooming.
The reception staff always seem to have a good grasp of past records, resulting in smooth service.
Also, being able to see the grooming process from outside gives me peace of mind.
The prices are standard and reasonable.
I bought a Pomeranian because the shop was clean and had lots of cute dogs, but the staff member was extremely unpleasant, so I won't buy from them again if she's there.

Coming from the US, it’s uncommon to see kittens and puppies on display like this. Average price is $1600USD. They look young and I saw a couple of puppies eating straight poo that had just been dumped out of the bowels of another puppy. The workers do their best to keep the area pristine, as if kittens and puppies don’t make a mess. It feels unnatural to see them licking from water bottles meant for guinea pigs. Makes me wonder what would happen if you actually bought one to raise.

They have a large selection of products and the staff are very friendly, but the grooming service seemed problematic.

There was a dog that had finished grooming, and it was fine to put it in a cage to wait, but when another dog's grooming was finished, they turned off the lights and left the place unattended.

I understand that it's unavoidable that the place will be unattended at times, but I wonder if it was really necessary to turn off the lights as well?

The dog looked so lonely while waiting.

Just seeing this, I got the impression that the groomers don't like animals. I was thinking of having my dog ​​groomed there, but seeing this made me not want to entrust it to them anymore.

It might have been a matter of timing, but it wasn't a good scene.

Well, from the groomers' perspective, it's just their job and it might not matter, but I felt sorry for the animal.

I was also worried about how the dogs were treated during grooming.

We adopted our dog from here.

They also provide excellent after-sales support.

I'll write in more detail now that I've received your reply. I adopted a cute puppy, but the store manager's attitude was dishonest and awful. Due to a mistake on the store's part, I was overcharged by almost 20,000 yen at checkout. A sincere apology and response would have been sufficient, but for some reason, the manager was crying (sob) while dealing with me... Also, other staff members (perhaps trying to lighten the mood?) suddenly brought up unrelated topics, which left a bad impression.
A haven for adorable puppies, where the staff are very good at playing with them.

The other day I had the opportunity to hold a cute dog. I've never had a dog before, so I didn't know what I needed or what I had to do, but the staff were very kind and explained everything to me from the very beginning. After discussing it with my child, if we were to get a dog, we would definitely choose this pet shop.

I think the employees who were there on the evening of July 3rd need better training.

I own cats and dogs myself and frequent pet shops, but I've never seen such terrible employees before.

A toy poodle's collar was too big and got stuck in its mouth, and it was clearly suffering, but the two of them were laughing and chatting, completely ignoring it. Someone nearby tapped on the glass to get their attention, but they just gave them a blank stare and didn't even say thank you!

The dog was eating its own feces, and I wanted to say something, but there were no employees around. When I asked a shop employee to go and get one, the two of them were flirting and laughing while they removed it. How can they do that?

Honestly, I want to include their names...
I was concerned because the dogs were eating poop. Was it theirs, or someone else's...? No staff members came out to see what was going on, so I guess that's what was happening?
It's spacious. The environment doesn't seem bad. The air at Aeon is bad. The staff won't come out, so I can't talk to them. Maybe it's just bad timing. Is it strange to feel sorry for microchips?

Thank you very much for visiting Pet Plus Osaka Dome City store.

We would appreciate it if you could share any opinions or requests you may have so that we can continue to meet your expectations.

All of our staff look forward to your next visit.
A little shop that carries a lot of adorable stuff for your furbabies.
